provider: GitHub Container Registry (GHCR) via ORAS — known, numbers re-verified

free_tier.stated: Container image storage and bandwidth are free: "Container image storage and bandwidth for the Container registry is currently free. If you use Container registry, you'll be informed at least one month in advance of any change to this policy." Ceiling is per-blob, not per-account: "The Container registry has a 10 GB size limit for each layer" and "a 10 minute timeout limit for uploads".

egress.terms: Free/unmetered per the billing page note above; blobs 307-redirect to pkg-containers.githubusercontent.com (Azure Blob, Fastly fronted).

tooling: oras-project/oras (2,474 stars) — `oras push` with `--artifact-type`, one file per layer, so the 10 GB/layer cap becomes the per-file cap. Docker/skopeo/crane also work. Androsh7/layerstash (1 star) is a purpose-built 'Data Storage Tool for Docker Hub and GHCR'.
chaining: unlimited repos x unlimited tags/versions x (10 GB per blob). A 30 TiB corpus = 3,000 x 10 GB ORAS layers, spread over any number of repos/tags; multiply by unlimited accounts and orgs. Effectively unbounded, capped only by upload throughput.
limits_note: 10 GB per layer (per file), 10 minute upload timeout per blob, anonymous PUSH denied, anonymous PULL allowed for public packages. npm/nuget/maven/ruby registries on the same product are NOT free like this — see dead ends.
